description: Department of Fiscal Policy - The Bilateral Agreement for Prevention of Fiscal Evasion entered into on 06.10.2015, between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Government of Poland
reasoning: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of a bilateral agreement for the avoidance of double taxation and prevention of fiscal evasion between Sri Lanka and Poland. It constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it involves the implementation of an international tax treaty under the Inland Revenue Act, which falls under the category of legal frameworks and regulatory matters.
